verdict.rationale: Groq is a hosted LLM inference API, so whether customer data is used for model training is a fair privacy question for this kind of product. However, nothing in the evidence pack addresses data retention, training use, zero-data-retention, or any opt-out control. The pack covers only API compatibility, tooling, service tiers, batch processing and billing, so the axis applies but is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
